description: The Engineering lane converts refined materials and finished machines into
progression tokens, each capped per material.
Click §eSubmit§r below to bank every eligible Engineering material you are
carrying — Create / Thermal / Mekanism metals, alloys, and machine blocks,

§7Items are consumed only when banked (never before), and only up to each
